episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Japan's legendary fixer must quiet a journalist who threatens to expose a breaking story.

episodes.title: Merry-Go-Round
episodes.summary: Ryutaro must help the prime minister, as Ichiro's mistress plots with a mysterious man.

episodes.title: It is a Necklace
episodes.summary: Ryutaro learns more about his children's lives. Meanwhile Yumiko's perfect life shows cracks.

episodes.title: I Want to See a Rise
episodes.summary: A scandal brews as Maruyama's brother is arrested and Yumiko discovers her husband's secret.

episodes.title: I Do Not Trust Your Justice
episodes.summary: Tensions grow as Ryutaro is uneasy about Ryu dating a foreign journalist. Ichiro goes back to Taka for more money, as his mistress, Nami tries to move on and dates another man.

episodes.title: A Permanent Solution
episodes.summary: Maruyama is confronted by new scandalous evidence about his brother. Ryutaro discovers a connection between his past connections and Ichiro's mistress.

episodes.title: He is What We Japanese Call a Kuromaku
episodes.summary: Maruyama's brother takes matters into his own hands as pressure mounts for Maruyama in the Diet. Yumiko's husband's dark past is revealed. Ryu and Sarah unravel the secrets.

episodes.title: A Long Days’ Drive
episodes.summary: A desperate Yumiko runs into her old boss as she tries to piece her life together. Ryutaro decides to fix Ichiro's relationship with his wife.

episodes.title: Where You Keep Your Owls
episodes.summary: Ryutaro is caught off guard with the latest votes in the legislature as he discovers that there is someone else who might be pulling the politicians' strings.

episodes.title: Revenge Starts Today
episodes.summary: The family is on the verge of collapse as each member must deal with the threat of the new fixer. Suspicions grow about who in the family could have betrayed Ryutaro.
